queue.descr: The markets were bleeding red. Bitcoin was crashening, Ethereum was gasping for air, and panic-selling bots were tearing the charts to shreds. Deep in the trenches of the decentralized web, the degens had lost all hope. Until The Snap happened. Out of the glowing green mist of the blockchain emerged Pepe, wearing a golden, neon-charged gauntlet known only as the Infinity Glove. He didn't come to save the traditional financial system; he came to make it dank. With a mischievous wink, Pepe raised his gloved hand and pointed toward the upper right corner of the universe. "In Glove We Trust," he whispered. Snap. Instantly, the charts flipped. The terrifying red candles violently mutated into massive, towering green pillars of pure, unadulterated profit. Rocket ships fueled by sheer meme energy ignited simultaneously, blasting past the old All-Time Highs and tearing through the stratosphere. Short-sellers dissolved into dust. The doubters were left stranded on Earth, watching in disbelief as a literal army of Pepe clones planted the $GLOVE flag directly into the lunar crust. The era of the 1000x yield had arrived, ruled not by suit-wearing bankers, but by a frog with a powerful fist and a community that refused to sell.
